decisions.reason: Clear external adoption and very strong fit with the firm's core travel-security services make this a valuable option with low reason to abandon.
The module is adjacent to the firm's established training offer and should be relatively cheap to maintain while cross-selling potential continues to unfold.
After two years without clear evidence of market validation, its higher operational and compliance burden means the option value no longer justifies keeping it open.
The web platform remains closely complementary to the firm's passenger and document-processing activities, so keeping it preserves a plausible digital growth option at manageable cost.
